director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
mujhe nahi pata
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naap sakte hain. Aaj dekhenge ki naapna kahan se shuru karte hain. Tumhare scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, aise har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Ek pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 6 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi: 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: saat centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 1 se 8 tak 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: twelve

Sahi jawab. 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai, kyunki 4 + 8 = 12. Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain.

director.text: Nahi, yeh nahi hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: sawaal kya hai?
Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 7 centimetre lambi

Bilkul sahi: tehni 5 se 12 tak hai, aur 12 − 5 = 7, jo 5 se 12 tak ke khaanon ki ginti hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: four centimetres
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 5 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 4 khaane hain, 9 − 5 = 4. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal lamba hai

Sahi jawab. Laal 0 se 7 tak hai, toh 7 centimetre; neela 3 se 9 tak, toh 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 15 cm

15 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya
Chabi ke neeche wale khaane 6 ke nishaan se ginna shuru karo. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: picture dikhao
Yahan toote scale ka shuru wala tukda bada karke hai: chabi 6 ke nishaan se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 2 se nahi. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: 4 centimetre lambi

Bilkul sahi: 6 se 10 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 4 khaane hain, 10 − 6 = 4. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: 15 cm
Nahi, 15 cm theek nahi. 15 aakhri nishaan hai, lambai nahi; grip 6 se shuru hota hai, toh 6 tak ke khaane uske neeche nahi. Toote scale par 6 se 15 tak wale grip ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: hindi mein batao na
Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. Bat pakadne wali jagah 6 wale nishaan se 15 wale tak hai. Woh jagah kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Bat pakadne wali jagah 6 wale nishaan se 15 wale tak hai. Woh jagah kitne centimetre ki hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: nau cm

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki grip 6 se 15 tak hai: 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, toh 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, yeh naap le lene ke baad. Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain. Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

seams.form: Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: phir se bolo
Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 70 cm
70 cm sahi nahi hai. 70 toh bat ki apni lambai hai; poocha yeh hai ki bat ke upar se metre ke aakhri nishaan tak kitna bacha. 70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: tees
Bilkul sahi. Metre 100 centimetre ka hai aur bat 70 tak aata hai, toh 100 − 70 = 30 centimetre bacha. Cricket mein kya kuch aisa hai jise tum naap sakte ho?
jab Virat chauka maarta hai, woh

Wah, chauka! Yeh batane ke liye shukriya. Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain.

j2.line: Wah, chauka! Yeh batane ke liye shukriya.

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. 10 centimetre toh metre ka bas ek chhota tukda hai. Uske baad 90 centimetre aur aate hain, tab poore 100 centimetre ka ek metre banta hai. Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?
director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

director.text: 1 metre 3 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Is feete ke khaane scale jaise 1-1 centimetre ke nahi; ek metre ke 100 centimetre yahan das hi khaanon mein bante hain. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aane wali mez kitne metre aur centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

director.text: 130 centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek: mez 1 metre wale nishaan se 3 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 30 centimetre. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Pehle dekho, nishaan kitne poore metre ke baad aata hai. Phir uske aage ke chhote khaane gino, har ek 10 centimetre ka. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak wala parda kitne metre aur kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 1 metre 40 centimetre

Bilkul sahi, kyunki parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Toh 105 centimetre. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 208 centimetre

Sahi jawab. 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: convert to centimetres

Haan, pehle 3 metre ko centimetre mein badlenge, kyunki 40 centimetre mein hai. 300 mein se 40 gaye, toh 260 centimetre rassi bachi. Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?

director.text: 26 metre
Nahi, 26 metre theek nahi. 26 metre toh 2600 centimetre hote; har metre 100 centimetre ka hai, 10 ka nahi. 260 centimetre kitne metre aur kitne centimetre hain?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?

director.text: 26 metre
26 metre sahi nahi hai. 260 mein se poore metre jitne tukde alag karo. Jo bache, woh centimetre mein likho. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

director.text: do metre saath centimetre

Bilkul sahi: 3 metre 300 centimetre hai, 300 − 40 = 260, aur 260 mein do poore 100 aur 60 bache. Toh poora jawab: bachi hui rassi 2 metre aur 60 centimetre hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Bijli ka ek khamba 6 metre ooncha hai. Khamba kitne centimetre ooncha hai?
director.card: Bijli ka ek khamba 6 metre ooncha hai. Khamba kitne centimetre ooncha hai?

director.text: 600 cm hai na
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki har metre 100 centimetre, toh 6 metre = 600 centimetre. Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?
director.card: Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?

director.text: 5 cm
5 cm se baat nahi bani. 5 tab hota jab metre 10 centimetre ka hota; metre toh 100 centimetre ka hai, aur aadha usi ka lena hai. Ek metre ka aadha kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?

director.text: 5 cm
Nahi, 5 cm theek nahi. Pehle yaad karo, poora metre kitne centimetre ka hai. Phir use do barabar tukdon mein baanto. Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.
director.card: Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?

seams.form: Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 50 cm
Sahi jawab. 1 metre 100 centimetre hai, aur 100 ka aadha 50. Ek dupatta 1 metre ka hai, ek ribbon 90 centimetre ki, aur ek dori 95 centimetre ki. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: dupatta, ribbon ya dori?
director.card: Ek dupatta 1 metre ka hai, ek ribbon 90 centimetre ki, aur ek dori 95 centimetre ki. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: dupatta, ribbon ya dori?

director.text: dori

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Tumne sirf number milaaye, 95, 90 aur 1; 1 metre ko centimetre mein likho, phir teeno milao. 1 metre ka dupatta, 90 centimetre ki ribbon, 95 centimetre ki dori: inmein sabse lamba kaun hai?
director.card: Ek dupatta 1 metre ka hai, ek ribbon 90 centimetre ki, aur ek dori 95 centimetre ki. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: dupatta, ribbon ya dori?

director.text: dupatta lamba hai

Bilkul sahi: dupatta 1 metre, yaani 100 centimetre hai, jo dori ke 95 aur ribbon ke 90 centimetre se zyada hai. Ab tum metre aur centimetre dono jaante ho. Aage dekhenge ki bina scale ke ungli aur lambe kadam se andaaza kaise lagate hain, aur kis cheez ke liye kaunsi unit. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Thakaan ho toh aaram karna bilkul theek hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
